items.title_kr: Kohl's, Arianne Parisi를 Chief Customer Officer로 승진 임명
items.title_en: Kohl’s Elevates Arianne Parisi to Chief Customer Officer
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Arianne Parisi를 Chief Customer Officer로 임명하며 고객 경험 강화에 나섰습니다. 향후 customer engagement 전략과 retail 성과 변화를 모니터링할 필요가 있습니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has promoted Arianne Parisi to Chief Customer Officer to drive customer experience and engagement strategies. Vendor teams should monitor upcoming shifts in retail performance.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Maya Dukes를 Senior Vice President, Creative and Production으로 영입
items.title_en: Macy’s Welcomes Maya Dukes as Senior Vice President, Creative and Production
items.body_kr: Macy's가 Maya Dukes를 SVP로 영입하여 creative와 production 역량을 강화합니다. 향후 merchandise presentation과 seasonal campaign의 크리에이티브 방향성에 주목해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Macy's has appointed Maya Dukes as Senior Vice President, Creative and Production to strengthen brand presentation. Vendor partners should watch for new creative directions in upcoming campaigns.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Tommy Hilfiger 및 Michael Kors 등과 손잡고 exclusive Capsule Collection 공개
items.title_en: Tommy Hilfiger, Michael Kors and More Designers Team Up with Macy’s for Limited-Edition Capsule Collections
items.body_kr: Macy's가 유명 designer들과 협업하여 limited-edition Capsule Collection을 선보였습니다. 주요 retail channel에서의 merchandise sell-through와 traffic 유입 효과를 주시해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Macy's has partnered with prominent designers to launch exclusive limited-edition capsule collections. Vendor teams should track sell-through rates and traffic impact across retail channels.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, margin pressure 속 실적 발표 앞두고 브랜드 모멘텀 주목
items.title_en: Abercrombie earnings ahead as margin pressure tests momentum
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch가 실적 발표를 앞둔 가운데 margin pressure가 브랜드의 성장세를 시험대에 올리고 있습니다. 향후 pricing 전략과 inventory 관리가 실적의 주요 변수가 될 것입니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch faces upcoming earnings where margin pressure will test its ongoing brand momentum. Pricing strategy and inventory management remain key watchpoints for vendors.

items.title_kr: Macy's, 100주년 Thanksgiving Day Parade 앞두고 100일 카운트다운 돌입
items.title_en: Macy’s Kicks Off the 100-Day Countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®
items.body_kr: Macy's가 제100회 Thanksgiving Day Parade를 앞두고 100일 카운트다운을 시작하며 Holiday 시즌 마케팅 포문을 열었습니다. 향후 Holiday merchandise 기획과 Partnership 상품 전개에 큰 영향을 미칠 것입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's has kicked off the 100-day countdown to its milestone 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade, setting the stage for Holiday marketing. This signature event heavily influences seasonal merchandise planning and vendor partnerships.

items.title_kr: Ted by Ted Baker 신규 menswear collection, Macy's에서 공식 론칭
items.title_en: Ted by Ted Baker brand new menswear collection debuts at Macy's
items.body_kr: Ted by Ted Baker의 새로운 menswear collection이 Macy's를 통해 성공적으로 데뷔했습니다. 남성복 category의 retail 반응과 초기 sell-through 추이가 주목됩니다.
items.body_en: The new menswear collection from Ted by Ted Baker has officially debuted at Macy's. Vendor partners are closely monitoring retail reception and initial sell-through trends in the category.
items.source: FashionNetwork - The World's Fashion Business News

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch의 Carey Collins Krug, Vuori로 이직
items.title_en: Abercrombie & Fitch’s Carey Collins Krug Joins Vuori
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch의 핵심 임원이었던 Carey Collins Krug가 activewear 브랜드 Vuori로 합류했습니다. 주요 경쟁사의 리더십 변화가 향후 마케팅 및 merchandising 전략에 미칠 파장에 관심이 집중됩니다.
items.body_en: Carey Collins Krug, a key executive at Abercrombie & Fitch, has moved to activewear brand Vuori. Industry observers are tracking how leadership shifts will influence competitive marketing and merchandising strategies.

items.title_kr: Hollister Co., 샬럿 SouthPark Mall에 매장 재입점 추진
items.title_en: Hollister Co. Set to Return to SouthPark Mall in Charlotte
items.body_kr: Hollister Co.가 미국 샬럿의 주요 거점인 SouthPark Mall에 offline store 재입점을 확정했습니다. 브랜드의 retail footprint 확장 전략과 매장별 traffic 회복세에 긍정적인 신호입니다.
items.body_en: Hollister Co. is slated to return to SouthPark Mall in Charlotte, expanding its brick-and-mortar retail footprint. This move signals continued confidence in physical store traffic and regional retail demand.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, DoorDash를 통한 Back-to-School 당일 배송 서비스 확대
items.title_en: Back-to-school essentials now available for delivery on DoorDash
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 DoorDash partnership을 기반으로 Back-to-school 필수품의 당일 배송 서비스를 강화했습니다. E-commerce fulfillment와 delivery channel 다각화가 매출 견인에 기여하고 있습니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's has expanded its back-to-school delivery lineup via DoorDash for same-day fulfillment. This e-commerce and delivery partnership enhancement aims to capture urgent seasonal demand.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Back-to-school 시즌 맞이 공격적인 promotion 및 Kohl's Cash 혜택 제공
items.title_en: Kohl's is stacking back-to-school deals — and shoppers have a shot at $100 in free Kohl's Cash
items.body_kr: Kohl's가 Back-to-school 쇼핑객을 겨냥해 다양한 할인 혜택과 Kohl's Cash 리워드를 결합한 promotion을 진행합니다. value-seeking 소비자를 사로잡기 위한 pricing 및 promotion 전략이 주목됩니다.
items.body_en: Kohl's is rolling out stacked back-to-school deals and Kohl's Cash rewards to attract value-conscious shoppers. The aggressive promotion highlights current retail pricing strategies for the peak season.
